_about: The conversation eval's own postings, added to the e2e world's 20 (evals/career/tasks/tasks.json + e2e/tasks.json extra_postings). Fictional employers on made-up boards; the stub ATS answers every one (127.0.0.1); nothing reaches a real employer. `scale` is the SCALE scenario's batch (pasted as links). `person` is every scenario's fictional person: the e2e fixture resume with a real two-word name and a plain contact line, so a confirmed header can fill first name, last name, email and phone.
